acceptance.scope: formal private release, final metadata promotion, tag and GitHub Release; public visibility and primary installation excluded

workAcceptance.scope: MNT-0010 through MNT-0019; original failures and remediation evidence retained

upstream.range: no new upstream adoption; accepted fixed baseline

behaviorEvidence.limitations: Fixed representative tasks, not exhaustive equivalence; original attempts retain actual versions

verification.publicContentScope: allowlisted export and actual destination HEAD history; private history excluded
verification.secretScannerScope: private HEAD/tree and actual destination HEAD/tree separately reviewed; no external credential verification; final release metadata and tag annotation rescanned before publication

ciAttempt.followUp: original failure retained; MNT-0019 accepted and Windows rerun passed in ciVerification

ciVerification.scope: accepted MNT-0019 code/test commit; later documentation checkpoint not yet pushed or run in CI

promotionVerification.scope: accepted payload and testing code; final release metadata commit requires its own pre-tag CI readback

destinationAudit.scope: original destination baseline; actual scanned promotion is recorded separately in promotionVerification; final metadata and tag verified externally before release
